caption: Field validation of GapTrust on six measured profiles. (a)-(c) Karst lines of the Guilin sites, 400 MHz antenna; (d)-(f) Aquileia profiles, 250 MHz (Zhao et al., 2013). Boxes mark the target (+/-0.25 m, +/-0.15 m), arrows the gap width at W50; display gain only. (g)-(i) Recovery ratio R versus gap number G for zero fill, linear interpolation and POCS; dashed line R = 0.5, shaded band the G50 range of the models (0.70-1.70), open symbols the G50 of each method. POCS raises R above unity, so panels are annotated rather than rescaled.
